data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for authentication using Twitter APIs OAuth service
data.what_it_does: Provides a way to authenticate users with their Twitter accounts in a Flutter application. Handles the OAuth login flow, supporting Android, iOS, and macOS platforms.
use_when: You need to allow users to sign in to your Flutter app using their Twitter account
You are targeting Android, iOS, or macOS and need Twitter OAuth integration
avoid_when: You require sign-in methods for other social providers without additional packages
You are not using Twitter/X APIs for authentication
strengths: Cross-platform support including Android, iOS, and macOS
Handles cancellations and error statuses smoothly
weaknesses: Requires manual native configuration for intent filters and URL schemes
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up a Twitter Developer account, configuring callback URLs, adding intent filters in AndroidManifest.xml, and adding URL schemes in Info.plist for iOS.
